reflection.text:
Unblinded truth: cytochalasin B - Actin disruptors. We submitted Microtubule stabilizers p=0.78. Incorrect.

What evidence did what:

We sampled 4 wells single-replicate: dose 2 (0.1 uM, e6), dose 3 (0.3 uM, e7), dose 4 (1 uM, e2, 360 cells), dose 6 (10 uM, e3, 412 cells). Dose-response was monotonic and striking: tub_mean z +2.7 to +27.7 rho=+1.00 e9, tub_std +23.0 at high dose e3 rho=+0.80 e15, frac_multinucleate_proxy +3.4 to +14.9 rho=+1.00 e10, cell_area -4.1 to -12.1 rho=-1.00 e11, nuc_area 0 to -10.7 rho=-1.00 e12, act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 e13 peaking at z=+36.0 e3. Phenotype e5 reported density lower vs DMSO, bundled bright tubulin asters/bundles, rounded cells, 43-61% bi/multinucleate vs 20% DMSO, punctate peripheral actin, and nominated Microtubule stabilizers.

That phenotype description plus the huge tubulin signal is what anchored us and misled us. We interpreted tub_mean +7.5 at 1 uM e2 and +27.7 at 10 uM e3 plus increased tub_std/bundling texture as direct tubulin polymerization/stabilization - opposite to destabilizers - and treated multinucleation plus decreased cell and nuclear area and cell_nuc_area_ratio -3.0 e6, -5.0 e7 as failed cytokinesis secondary to mitotic arrest/bundling. We explicitly down-weighted the atlas: NSC vote over 2 wells e4 Cholesterol-lowering 1/2, k-neighbors Protein synthesis 5/10, Cholesterol-lowering 2/10, Eg5 2/10; over 4 wells e8 NSC Cholesterol-lowering 2/4, neighbors Epithelial 5/10, Cholesterol-lowering 2/10, Protein synthesis 2/10 - zero votes for Microtubule stabilizers. We rationalized this as "discordant atlas correctly down-weighted vs direct tubulin phenotype" and still assigned 0.78 to stabilizers e16/e17, with Actin disruptors only 0.07 despite act_glcm_contrast +36.0 being the largest z-score in the dataset.

In hindsight the measurements contained the correct answer we underweighted:

1. Actin metric dominance: act_glcm_contrast z=+36.0 e3, dose-dependent e13 rho=+1.00, plus punctate peripheral actin in e5, is the expected primary lesion of cytochalasin B which caps barbed ends and shortens filaments PMID 6893016, PMID 8204105, PMID 6654878. We listed it as supporting e3/e5/e13 for Actin disruptors in e16 but argued "actin puncta alone cannot explain tub increase" - wrong. Cell rounding and area collapse rho=-1.00 e11 (-8.4 e2) concentrates tubulin immunofluorescence per pixel and alters texture, creating an apparent tub_mean/tub_std increase without polymerization. No paper in this run supports tubulin bundling by cytochalasin B - our search e21 for cytochalasin B multinucleation microtubule tubulin bundling returned 0 hits.

2. Multinucleation mechanism misattributed: Both MoAs cause multinucleation but differently. Cytochalasin B inhibition of actin polymerization is known to induce polyploidization PMID 9568120 and its classic laboratory use is cytokinesis-block to generate binucleated cells for micronucleus assays PMID 12106653, PMID 10982178. Our e2/e10 multinucleation proxy was therefore correctly measuring cytokinesis failure, not mitotic slippage from stabilization. We noted frac_multinucleate_proxy dose-dependence e10 but assigned it to stabilizers.

3. Negative control we ignored: frac_mitotic_like was constant across acquired wells e14. Microtubule stabilizers at 1-10 uM should increase mitotic index; flat mitotic fraction argues against. We acknowledged in review "mitotic fraction flat at 0.0" but did not downgrade. Decreasing nuc_area e12 argues against Aurora (which we used correctly) but does not distinguish stabilizer from actin disruptor cytokinesis failure.

4. Acquisition choices: With 8 doses available e1 we chose to bracket EC50 with 4 mid-high doses single replicate, exhausted budget, and relied on morphology/Tubulin intensity alone. We did not acquire a direct tubulin polymerization readout, acetylated/detyrosinated tubulin, EB1 comets, phospho-H3, or DNA content ploidy trajectory that would have shown: no microtubule stabilization, no mitotic arrest, progressive bi-nucleation with intact interphase microtubules. Lookup e18/e19 showed no curated ChEMBL mechanism for this CID, so we had no chemical prior to correct the visual bias.

Correct inference would have weighted: strongest effect is actin contrast/texture e3/e13, early multinucleation at low dose 0.1 uM e6 without mitotic increase e14, cell area contraction e11, and atlas non-support for stabilizers e4/e8, plus punctate actin in e5, as Actin disruptor cytokinesis failure consistent with cytochalasin B actin capping activity PMID 6893016 and polyploidization PMID 9568120.
what_was_right: Actin disruptor signature was present: act_glcm_contrast +36.0 at 10 uM (e3), rho=+1.00 e13, punctate peripheral actin in e5. Hypothesis list e16 retained Actin disruptors 0.07 with supporting e3/e5/e13.
Multinucleation phenotype correctly measured: frac_multinucleate_proxy +8.4 at 1 uM e2 to +14.9 at 10 uM e3, rho=+1.00 e10, with e5 43-61% bi/multinucleate vs 20% DMSO.
Decreased cell area and nuclear area correctly noted (e2 -8.4, e11 rho=-1.00, e12 rho=-1.00) and e5 lower density, consistent with rounding and cytokinesis failure.
what_was_wrong: Interpreted tub_mean +27.7 e3 / +7.5 e2 and tub_std +23.0 e3 dose-dependent e9/e15 as microtubule stabilization/bundling per e5 microscopist nomination. Post-unblinding this is secondary concentration/texture after actin collapse and cell shrinkage e11, not polymerization. No literature hit for tubulin bundling e21.

Overrode reference atlas: NSC Cholesterol-lowering 1/2 e4 and 2/4 e8, neighbors Protein synthesis/Epithelial, with zero stabilizer votes, correctly signaled lack of stabilizer match. We down-weighted it.
Dismissed constant frac_mitotic_like e14 which contradicted stabilizer-induced mitotic arrest.

Underweighted the dominant actin effect size (+36.0 > +27.7) and treated multinucleation as stabilizer-driven while cytochalasin B is a canonical cytokinesis-block actin drug PMID 6893016 PMID 9568120 PMID 12106653.

No paper in this run supports tubulin bundling by cytochalasin B - our search e21 for cytochalasin B multinucleation microtubule tubulin bundling returned 0 hits.

2. Multinucleation mechanism misattributed: Both MoAs cause multinucleation but differently. Cytochalasin B inhibition of actin polymerization is known to induce polyploidization PMID 9568120 and its classic laboratory use is cytokinesis-block to generate binucleated cells for micronucleus assays PMID 12106653, PMID 10982178. Our e2/e10 multinucleation proxy was therefore correctly measuring cytokinesis failure, not mitotic slippage from stabilization. We noted frac_multinucleate_proxy dose-dependence e10 but assigned it to stabilizers.

3. Negative control we ignored: frac_mitotic_like was constant across acquired wells e14. Microtubule stabilizers at 1-10 uM should increase mitotic index; flat mitotic fraction argues against. We acknowledged in review "mitotic fraction flat at 0.0" but did not downgrade. Decreasing nuc_area e12 argues against Aurora (which we used correctly) but does not distinguish stabilizer from actin disruptor cytokinesis failure.

4. Acquisition choices: With 8 doses available e1 we chose to bracket EC50 with 4 mid-high doses single replicate, exhausted budget, and relied on morphology/Tubulin intensity alone. We did not acquire a direct tubulin polymerization readout, acetylated/detyrosinated tubulin, EB1 comets, phospho-H3, or DNA content ploidy trajectory that would have shown: no microtubule stabilization, no mitotic arrest, progressive bi-nucleation with intact interphase microtubules. Lookup e18/e19 showed no curated ChEMBL mechanism for this CID, so we had no chemical prior to correct the visual bias.

Correct inference would have weighted: strongest effect is actin contrast/texture e3/e13, early multinucleation at low dose 0.1 uM e6 without mitotic increase e14, cell area contraction e11, and atlas non-support for stabilizers e4/e8, plus punctate actin in e5, as Actin disruptor cytokinesis failure consistent with cytochalasin B actin capping activity PMID 6893016 and polyploidization PMID 9568120.

What was right:
- Actin disruptor signature was present: act_glcm_contrast +36.0 at 10 uM (e3), rho=+1.00 e13, punctate peripheral actin in e5. Hypothesis list e16 retained Actin disruptors 0.07 with supporting e3/e5/e13.
- Multinucleation phenotype correctly measured: frac_multinucleate_proxy +8.4 at 1 uM e2 to +14.9 at 10 uM e3, rho=+1.00 e10, with e5 43-61% bi/multinucleate vs 20% DMSO.
- Decreased cell area and nuclear area correctly noted (e2 -8.4, e11 rho=-1.00, e12 rho=-1.00) and e5 lower density, consistent with rounding and cytokinesis failure.

What was wrong or missed:
- Interpreted tub_mean +27.7 e3 / +7.5 e2 and tub_std +23.0 e3 dose-dependent e9/e15 as microtubule stabilization/bundling per e5 microscopist nomination. Post-unblinding this is secondary concentration/texture after actin collapse and cell shrinkage e11, not polymerization. No literature hit for tubulin bundling e21.
- Overrode reference atlas: NSC Cholesterol-lowering 1/2 e4 and 2/4 e8, neighbors Protein synthesis/Epithelial, with zero stabilizer votes, correctly signaled lack of stabilizer match. We down-weighted it.
- Dismissed constant frac_mitotic_like e14 which contradicted stabilizer-induced mitotic arrest.
- Underweighted the dominant actin effect size (+36.0 > +27.7) and treated multinucleation as stabilizer-driven while cytochalasin B is a canonical cytokinesis-block actin drug PMID 6893016 PMID 9568120 PMID 12106653.

Proposed next experiment: If this were real lab: side-by-side high-content time course vs latrunculin/cytochalasin B and taxol controls with pHH3, DNA content, acetylated tubulin and EB1 comets; in vitro tubulin polymerization +/- compound; washout of actin puncta and tubulin intensity concentrated by cell area normalization.
